## 🛠️ Project Tasks: "Fine-Tune, Don't Derive"
- [ ] Source a small pretrained transformer (e.g., DistilBERT or small GPT-style model)
- [ ] Set up the dataset preprocessing natively in PyTorch
- [ ] Build the fine-tuning loop completely from scratch using native PyTorch (No Hugging Face Trainer)
- [ ] Log training curves over epochs
- [ ] Generate and plot attention visualizations

## 🏁 Operational Checkpoint
- [ ] **Verification:** Given a training loss that plateaus, can you list 3 concrete things you would check before modifying the model architecture?
